rationale.complete: Rounds 1 and 2 done. Round 1: dated predictions, nulls, rivals, impostor table, synthetic validation on all 9 regime-III skeletons, replication (4 scorable), natives NE41, G38, G51, confirm script frozen (not run). Round 2 (2026-10-05): own content in prompt tokens (R1), erasure dose and the NE22 cap (R2), memory containment of erased sources (R3), each with predictions and a synthetic validation on the real skeletons before real data, four dated amendments, 35 estimates rows. Missing: holdout run, a fresh test of the post hoc memory moderation, NE03 (no first stage).
rationale.faithfulness: The context-held part is well supported: source-location enrichment 3.4x [2.6, 4.5] in 4/4 scorable periods, pseudo-erasure ~1, NE41 exit 2.4x. Round 2 beats two rivals: own-content density (tool tokens b_U -0.47 [-1.31, 0.37], power 0.93) and a proportional erasure dose (0.24 [-0.06, 0.53] per log unit, 0.7 excluded). Memory as a pooled residual carrier fails as frozen (OR 3.09 [0.67, 14.1]) though G51 (31.7) and G38 (7.0) show it; salience is not separable. Scorecard A1 B1 C1 D1 E1 F2 G1 H1 I1.
rationale.usefulness: Concrete lever with numbers: erasing the agent's chat context breaks restatement loops (exit 2.4x, onset 0.54x) at any context size; trimming tool output does not help; nudges do not (0.81x). Check memory before a reset: in #51, 73% of cross-erasure loops restate memory text, and (post hoc) an erasure then helps less (0.42x). Limited by four scorable periods and period heterogeneity.

one_line: Restatement loops are copies from the context window (source in context 3.4x) that an erasure ends as a step, not a dose; own tool tokens do not trigger them, novel input does not end them, and memory carries erased sources only in some periods.

models.note: context-held self-coupling yes (by calls, not tokens); erasure is a step field; share threshold and input field no
restatement is copying from in-context own statements

v2.claim: Restatement loops copy what the agent's context still holds, and an erasure ends them as a step, not a dose: in-context enrichment OR 3.38 [2.56, 4.46] in 4/4 scorable periods; exit × own tokens removed 1.26 [0.95, 1.69] per log unit, with a 2×-per-log-unit dose excluded at power 1.00

v2.decision: scaffold design: cap the agent's own chat in context; check memory before a reset (H44: most flagged loops are productive, so a reset is not a free loop breaker)
v2.rater: 2 raters (coordinator + blind); log-odds mean credence, mean V; mechanism level = lower of the two; Δp 0.06, ΔV 0.50 (no adjudication needed)
